mira.s: heads-up: small external pentest scheduled Mon 2026-07-12 09:00-11:00 UTC. scope = staging only; need RBAC snapshot + KMS readroom policy.

ben.platform: ack. we'll mirror prod auth flows in staging. provide list of service ARNs we allow.

laura.audit: we need CloudTrail snapshot and SIEM filter for kms:Decrypt and s3:PutObject during window. retention for snapshot = 30d.

sam.oncall: I'll run the dry-run tomorrow 18:00 UTC to validate readroom pipeline (lambda copy -> encrypted S3). post revocation steps in runbook.

jenna.reports: I'll create intake ticket and tracker (label pentest/2026-07). tracker fields: triage_owner, evidence_bucket, synthetic_kms_key_arn, retest_slots.

pt-bot: PEN-TEST: Assessor "atlas-red" scheduled 2026-07-12T09:00Z. handshake key uploaded.

mira.s: policy: no live prompt or customer data in readroom. all samples must be synthetic or redacted. require signed DPA addendum before key provisioning.

ben.platform: ephemeral grant TTL 3h. will post minimal IAM snippet in runbook.

laura.audit: include explicit audit log retention export step and checksum. we'll attach to ticket as evidence.

sam.oncall: owners = runbook/oncall:sam.oncall; provisioning:ben.platform; intake:jenna.reports; audit:laura.audit. dry-run invite sent.

mira.s: thanks. if vendor requests scope change, deny and escalate to #incidents. :warning:
